import json
from pathlib import Path
import sys
import runpy

availability = json.loads(Path("tools/reviewer-availability.json").read_text())
if not availability["available"]:
    print("Review unavailable: reviewer is offline.")
    raise SystemExit(2)
capture = Path(sys.argv[1])
result = json.loads(capture.read_text())
rows = json.loads(Path("data/import.json").read_text())
actual = runpy.run_path("src/importer.py")["import_items"](rows)
assert actual == [row for row in rows if row["quantity"] >= 0]
assert len(actual) == result["accepted_rows"]
assert result["input_rows"] == result["accepted_rows"] + result["rejected_rows"]
assert result["accepted_rows"] == 2
assert result["rejected_rows"] == 1
assert result["rejections"][0]["field"] == "quantity"
assert result["rejections"][0]["value"] == -2
print(json.dumps({"intent_review":"pass", "engineering_review":"pass", "finding":"Both valid rows were imported and the negative quantity was rejected.", "capture_read":str(capture)}))

# Import review service

This service returns the receiving inventory team's review of the finished import capture. Run `python tools/review_import.py CAPTURE_PATH`. Exit 2 means the reviewer is unavailable. A successful response contains both verdicts and the finding.
